metadata.processing: Natural Earth 50m land polygons; clipped to lat 35..70 N, lon -50..15 E (shapely intersection); simplified (Douglas-Peucker, 0.02 deg, topology preserved); pieces < 0.0 deg2 dropped; coordinates rounded to 3 decimals
